description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ElasticSearchClientBuilder component in the SuiteCRM project. It contains tests for loading configuration, parsing URLs, and obtaining an ElasticSearch client instance.

classes.name: ElasticSearchClientBuilderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ElasticSearchClientBuilder, testing client creation, configuration loading, and URL parsing.

methods.name: testGetClient
methods.description: Verifies that getClient() returns an instance of Elasticsearch Client.

methods.name: testLoadConfig
methods.description: Tests loading Elasticsearch configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: testLoadConfigFileNotThere
methods.description: Tests fallback to default configuration when the config file does not exist.

methods.name: testLoadSugarConfig
methods.description: Tests loading configuration from global $sugar_config array with specified host, user, pass.

methods.name: testLoadSugarConfig2
methods.description: Tests loading configuration with a different set of values from $sugar_config.

methods.name: testLoadSugarConfig3
methods.description: Tests loading configuration with host only, when user and pass are empty.

methods.name: loadFromSugarConfig
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the private method loadFromSugarConfig in the builder.

methods.name: sanitizeHost
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the private method sanitizeHost for URL/host parsing.

methods.name: testUrlParser1
methods.description: Tests parsing a host with a plain hostname.

methods.name: testUrlParser2
methods.description: Tests parsing a URL with scheme and user.

methods.name: testUrlParser3
methods.description: Tests parsing a URL with scheme, host, port, user, and pass.

methods.name: testUrlParser4
methods.description: Tests parsing a complex URL with embedded user pass and port.

methods.name: testUrlParser5
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if 'host' key is missing.

methods.name: testUrlParser6
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if 'host' value is invalid (not a string).

methods.name: testUrlParserBadUrls
methods.description: Tests invalid URL formats to ensure exceptions are raised.
